answer.reason: Judea is a whole region, but two events belong to it in the story: John's baptizing, which drew all its people, and Jesus' stay there with his disciples.

clauses.english: sent its people out to John to be baptized in the Jordan
clauses.quote: there went out unto him all the land of Judaea

clauses.english: was where Jesus tarried with his disciples and baptized
clauses.quote: into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized

doubts: Many marked verses only mention Judaea in passing (multitudes coming from it, people fleeing to the mountains, churches in it), so they were left out.
LUK 1:39 and MAT 2:6 speak of a city or land of Juda, which may be a different usage, so they were not used.
